description: Explainable 4-tier bibliography deduplication rules with anti-false-merge guardrails and field provenance priority.
anti_false_merge_rules: NEVER merge two records that carry two distinct, valid non-preprint DOIs.
NEVER merge two records by the same first author in the same year if normalized title similarity < 0.75.
NEVER silently overwrite conflicting metadata (e.g., conflicting publication years or non-overlapping page ranges); preserve canonical value and log conflict in field_conflicts.
